(a) `textPropsRoot()`'s decision table (tool, isVectorText, groupId, member-count equality, allMatch) -> result, all short-circuit `return null` except the final line: `state.tool!=='select'` -> null (8715); `!selectedPaths.length` -> null (8715); `!first||!first.data||!first.data.isVectorText||!first.data.groupId||!window.SMVectorText` -> null (8717, `first=selectedPaths[0]`); else `members=SMVectorText.vectorTextGroupMembers(first)` (8726), `root=members.filter(isTextRoot)[0]` (8727); `!root||selectedPaths.length!==members.length` -> null (8728, a PARTIAL pick — e.g. Shift-click removed one glyph, or a marquee that only grazed some members — has fewer selected paths than the group has members); else `allMatch=selectedPaths.every(p=>p.data.groupId===first.data.groupId)` (8729) -> `allMatch?root:null` (8730). The comment at 8718-8725 states WHY a partial/mixed pick returns null rather than the root anyway: it 'has no single coherent set of typography values to show or edit' — editing would silently apply to only some of the glyphs a plain click would otherwise have selected as one unit.

(b) The complete `d.*`<->`#tp-*` field map. READ direction (`updateTextPropsPanel`, mirrors `d.*` into DOM, each guarded by a focus check `if(document.activeElement!==el)` except the four button-class toggles which have no such guard): `d.text`->`#tp-content`.value, default `''` (8745); `d.vectorFont`->`#tp-font`.value with the `-Bold`/`-Regular` suffix stripped via regex, default `'Roboto-Regular'` before stripping (8751-8752, feedback #86 fix — was never synced before); `d.size`->`#tp-size`.value, default `48` (8754); `d.color`->`#tp-color`.value, default `'#000000'` (8756); `d.align`->`.tp-align-btn` `'ac'` class where `dataset.val===(d.align||'left')` (8757); `d[b.dataset.flag]` (bold/italic/underline/strike)->`.tp-style-btn` `'ac'` class, one per flag (8758); `d.textCase`->`.tp-case-btn` `'ac'` class where `dataset.val===(d.textCase||'none')` (8759); `d.letterSpacing`->`#tp-letter-spacing`.value, default `0` (8761); `d.lineHeightMult`->`#tp-line-height`.value, default `1.25` (8763); `d.wordSpacing`->`#tp-word-spacing`.value, default `0` (8765); `d.fixedWidth` (truthy)->`isFixed`, drives `.tp-width-btn` `'ac'` class (`'fixed'` vs implicit `'auto'`, 8767) and `#tp-fixed-width`'s own `display` (8769) and, if fixed, its `.value` default `300` (8770). WRITE direction (`applyTextPropsEdit`, reads DOM into `opts`/positional args): `#tp-content`.value->`text`, guarded non-empty via `.trim()` (8784-8785, `return` with NO write if empty — comment: 'same guard commitText uses', confirmed against `commitText`'s own identical `if(!txt.trim()||...)` guard at timeline.js:8503, C19z); `#tp-font`.value->`fontKey`, fallback `d.vectorFont||'Roboto'` (8789); `#tp-size`.value->`size` via `parseInt(...,10)`, fallback `d.size||48` (8790); `#tp-color`.value->`color`, fallback `d.color` (8791); `.tp-align-btn.ac`'s `dataset.val`->`align`, fallback `d.align||'left'` (8792-8793); `.tp-style-btn[data-flag="bold"|"italic"|"underline"|"strike"].ac`->`opts.bold`/`.italic`/`.underline`/`.strike` (booleans, 8795-8798); `#tp-letter-spacing`.value->`opts.letterSpacing` via `parseFloat`, default `0` (8799); `#tp-line-height`.value->`opts.lineHeightMult` via `parseFloat`, default `1.25` (8800); `#tp-word-spacing`.value->`opts.wordSpacing` via `parseFloat`, default `0` (8801); `.tp-case-btn.ac`'s `dataset.val`->`opts.textCase`, default `'none'` (8802); `.tp-width-btn.ac`'s `dataset.val==='fixed'` plus `#tp-fixed-width`.value->`fixedWidthWorld` via `parseFloat`, default `300`, else `null` (8804-8805). All nine fields (`text` excepted, passed positionally) plus `topLeft`/`layer` feed `buildVectorTextGroup(text,fontKey,size,color,align,fixedWidthWorld,topLeft,layer,opts)` (8825) in the EXACT positional order `buildVectorTextGroup`'s own signature declares (vector-text-bridge.js:208: `function buildVectorTextGroup(text, fontKey, size, color, align, fixedWidthWorld, topLeftWorld, layer, opts)`) — confirmed by direct read, no mismatch found.

(c) `applyTextPropsEdit`'s rebuild sequence in order, with lines: 1) `textPropsRoot()`, bail if null or no `SMVectorText` (8781-8782). 2) read `#tp-content`, bail (return, no write) if empty after trim (8784-8785). 3-9) read font/size/color/align/opts{bold,italic,underline,strike,letterSpacing,lineHeightMult,wordSpacing,textCase}/fixedWidthWorld from the live DOM (8789-8805). 10) `layer=root.parent` (8806). 11) `topLeft`: prefer `d.anchorTopLeft` (a `Point`), else derive from the CURRENT ink bounds of the group via `vectorTextGroupMembers(root).reduce(unite)` (8817-8822, comment 8807-8816 explains this is the feedback #37 anti-drift fix — ink bounds and the nominal-ascent anchor formula are NOT the same point, so re-deriving from ink bounds on every edit fed a drifted reference back into itself and visibly sank the text each time). 12) `pushUndo()` (8823). 13) remove every current group member (8824). 14) `buildVectorTextGroup(...).then(res=>{ if(res.paths.length) selectedPaths=res.paths.slice(); saveActiveLayerFrame(); updateUI(); if(SMEngineBridge) renderNow(); }).catch(e=>{ console.warn(...); showToast(SM.t('toastTextEditRebuildFailed')); })` (8825-8838) — on success, re-points `selectedPaths` at every fresh glyph (not just the root) so `textPropsRoot`'s own 'selection===whole group' contract still holds the instant `updateUI()`'s own re-render calls back into this panel; on failure, the OLD glyphs are already gone (step 13) and nothing is restored. TWIN comparison against `closeInPlaceTextEditor` (C19y, timeline.js:8254-8288, read directly): both share the identical core `pushUndo()`->remove-members->`buildVectorTextGroup(...)`->on-success set `selectedPaths`+`saveActiveLayerFrame()`+`updateUI()`+`renderNow()`->on-failure `console.warn`+`showToast(SM.t('toastTextEditRebuildFailed'))` (SAME toast key) shape (CLAUDE.md §3 twin hazard). What DIFFERS: (i) anchor source — `closeInPlaceTextEditor` (8274-8275) ALWAYS derives `topLeft` from current ink bounds, with NO `d.anchorTopLeft` check at all, i.e. it does NOT carry the feedback #37 anti-drift fix `applyTextPropsEdit` has; re-editing text CONTENT via the in-place/popover path can therefore still sink the text on every edit the way the panel used to before the fix (not confirmed as a live defect, no execution performed — flagged in `future_proposals`). (ii) isNew/cancel/unchanged-text handling — `closeInPlaceTextEditor` manages a create-vs-re-edit distinction (`isNew`, `discardNew()`/`restore()` closures, and a combined bail condition at 8269 covering `cancel`, missing root, empty text, OR '`!isNew` and text unchanged') that `applyTextPropsEdit` has no equivalent of — the Typography panel only ever edits an EXISTING selected root (via `textPropsRoot()`), never creates one, and rebuilds on EVERY `change`/`click`/`blur` event unconditionally (no 'did anything actually change' check). (iii) opts source — `applyTextPropsEdit` reads bold/italic/underline/strike/letterSpacing/lineHeightMult/wordSpacing/textCase FRESH from the panel's own live DOM state (8795-8802, since editing exactly these fields is the whole point) and separately re-reads fontKey/color/align/fixedWidth live (8789-8792, 8804-8805); `closeInPlaceTextEditor` (8271, 8278-8279) passes ALL of these straight through UNCHANGED from `d.*` (only the text content itself changed) and additionally sets `opts.fixedHeight=d.fixedHeight||null`, a field `applyTextPropsEdit`'s own `opts` object never sets.
